observed_outcome.error: Flow selected the requested references, but their exact backend IDs could not be verified for submit correlation. No generation request was sent.

root_cause: The frame picker returned the thumbnail identity in the asb:<token> form, while request correlation requires the exact project media UUID. The observer already maintains an ASB-to-UUID map and exposes it through read events, but the content picker did not query that map before returning the selected reference ID.

fix.description: Resolve selected image ASB identities to a UUID only from the observer's project-scoped media identity map. Require matching project ID, image type, and a valid UUID; keep the existing pre-dispatch fail-closed behavior when no unique mapping exists. Normalize expected upload IDs through the same resolver.
